description: Register a PinterestAdsResource (OAuth 2.0 bearer token) for the Pinterest Ads API for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

access_token_env_var.label: Access Token Env Var
access_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the Pinterest OAuth 2.0 access token (needs ads:read + ads:write scopes for activation)

app_id_env_var.label: App ID Env Var
app_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Pinterest App ID (optional, only needed for token refresh)

app_secret_env_var.label: App Secret Env Var
app_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the Pinterest App Secret (optional, only needed for token refresh)

api_base_url.label: API Base URL
api_base_url.description: Pinterest Ads API base URL (override for a different API version).

name: Pinterest Ads Resource
